sites.title: Airbnb Userscripts
sites.summary: Two userscripts for Airbnb: Property Plus adds quick actions, a draggable map, and nightly prices to listings, and Listing Score ranks search results.

scripts.name: Airbnb Property Plus
scripts.description: Adds quick actions, message templates, and pricing helpers on Airbnb listing pages

scripts.name: Airbnb Listing Score
scripts.description: Wilson lower-bound + page-relative scoring with color-coded score pills, text dimming, sort controls, and all-pages loading

sites.title: AliExpress Userscripts
sites.summary: Scores AliExpress search results by star rating and order volume together, and adds a small filter bar above the results.

scripts.name: AliExpress Review Score Color Borders
scripts.description: Score, filter, and highlight AliExpress search results

sites.summary: Scores Amazon search results by how well-supported each rating is, so a few glowing reviews never outrank a product with thousands of solid ones.

scripts.name: Amazon Review Score Color Borders

sites.title: Booking.com Userscripts
